change_summary: Route most follow-up (tool/ack) turns to gpt-4.1-mini; reserve gpt-4.1 for heavy-reasoning (>300 tokens or no tool calls).
reason_for_change: Average conversation has ~27 turns but only a handful involve real reasoning.
